text:
rachel: quick follow-up from the hallway usability test — three folks thought the sample project tiles were just previews, not actions. they clicked the screenshot and nothing happened so they assumed it's read-only.
diego: yep, the interactive affordance is weak. only the tiny 'Use' pill is clickable right now. seems like a hit-target + discoverability problem.
zara: copy nit: 'Use' is too vague. users read it as 'already in use' or 'use elsewhere'. suggestions: 'Create from template', 'Launch sample', or 'Start project' — prefer verb-first phrasing.
rachel: i prototyped two variants in the quick test: 1) entire tile clickable with subtle shadow on hover, 2) bigger CTA pill 'Start project' + clearer hover state. quick win is full-tile clickable.
diego: accessibility-bot flagged missing keyboard affordance: tiles are not focusable when navigating with keyboard; you can't open with Enter/Space.
accessibility-bot: automated report: missing tabindex on .sample-tile; role="button" recommended for clickable divs; add aria-pressed state if it's a toggle.
zara: also, when the sample modal opens, screen readers don't get the dialog label — NVDA reads only 'dialog' without title. we should set aria-labelledby to the modal heading.
rachel: layout debate: should the setup checklist live above the workspace or stay in the left rail? first-run testers want it visible above the fold, but returning users said it felt noisy.
diego: compromise idea: show a banner-style checklist at top on first-run only, with a 'Dismiss and pin to sidebar' option. track via localStorage + analytics event onboard.checklist_shown=top or onboard.checklist_dismissed.
zara: a11y addition: include a 'Skip checklist' skip-link at the top for screen-reader users to jump to main content; ensure it becomes visible on focus.
rachel: telemetry copy tweak: current checkbox 'Help us improve' reads as required. change to 'Share anonymous usage data (optional)' and add a tooltip 'how this data helps' linking to the privacy blurb.
diego: dev estimate: 1.5 days to make tiles keyboard focusable + add role attributes and focus outline; 1 day to implement full-tile click and analytics; 0.5 day for copy tweaks and tooltip.
zara: QA checklist request: keyboard nav test, screen reader title announcement, focus trap inside modal, visible focus ring at 3px contrast-compliant, CTA text update verified, analytics event fires.
rachel: i'll update the figma frames and push a tiny ticket with the variants and acceptance criteria. will ping when ready for review.
onboarding-bot: reminder: please link the final Figma frames in the ticket and add the 'first-run' flag to the rollout notes.
rachel: thanks all — i'll tag you once the ticket is live :rocket:
